caseNameFull: Abel Heriberto FABIAN-BALTAZAR v. UNITED STATES.

opinions.text: On petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit. Motion of petitioner for leave to proceed in forma pauperis and petition for writ of certiorari granted. Judgment vacated, and case remanded to the United States Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit for further consideration in light of Garza v. Idaho, 586 U.S. ----, 139 S.Ct. 738, --- L.Ed.2d ---- (2019).
